title_zh: 问清公共场馆的资助范围

scenario.label_zh: 拟定公共场馆资助询问信
scenario.goal_zh: 区分一般资助信息与具体申请问题并约定发送询问

context_zh: 虚构社区小组商量给当地政府写资助询问信，不提供政策或法律建议。
author: author-phase03-c

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Does the government fund repairs to community buildings, or only new projects?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: This page gives general information, but it doesn't answer that question.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Then let's ask for further details before we spend time on an application.

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Agreed. We should explain that our hall needs a new roof.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Should we say it isn't fair that the sports centre got support and we didn't?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: We don't know how that decision was made. Let's ask about the criteria, not assume the two cases are the same.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: You're right. I'll draft a short enquiry about repairs and eligibility.

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Send me the draft first, and we'll check it together.
